project: Public Quest interaction and two-device validation evidence for a seated multiplayer application

workload.reason: The current official-source matrix still marks haptics, spatial audio, accessibility and two-headset validation constraints not established. This assignment is narrower and materially distinct from the terminal pre-submit broad Quest-platform query.

public_research_query: Using only current official public primary sources published or updated through August 30, 2026, produce a dated evidence matrix for testing four unresolved capabilities in a native Unreal Engine 5.7 seated multiplayer application on Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S: (1) controller and hand-tracking feedback, including available haptics when hands replace controllers and safe modality-switch behavior; (2) spatial audio implementation and device validation, including supported Meta or Unreal interfaces and objective on-device checks; (3) accessibility and seated-comfort controls for dominant hand, reach, scale, contrast, text scale, reduced motion, recentering, tracking loss, and controller/hand switching; and (4) a two-headset test procedure that proves each client receives only its own concealed state while exercising reconnect and role changes. For each capability identify the exact official API or documentation path, supported versions and devices, required permissions or project settings, observable test procedure, pass/fail evidence, limitation, and contradiction. Use no more than 10 sources from Meta, Epic Games, Khronos, Android, or recognized accessibility standards bodies; prefer pages updated within 18 months and mark NOT ESTABLISHED when official evidence does not support a claim. Do not use repositories, private data, code, forums, blogs, social media, third-party tutorials, product recommendations, legal or store conclusions, or implementation verdicts.
objective: Return one bounded, cited, current primary-source packet that resolves four still-missing implementation and physical-validation evidence areas without receiving product context or authority.
non_goals: No repository, source-code, architecture, private-project, credential, account, Slack, Linear, provider-output or concealed-gameplay context
No repeat of the broad Quest compatibility matrix, audience research, comparable-product survey, cultural research, music-rights research or product-direction debate
No programming, voting, review verdict, acceptance decision, security conclusion, store conclusion, implementation authority or external write
